title: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via…
description: The VikBooking Hotel Booking Engine & PMS plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'guests[][][documents]' parameter. This affects all versions up to and including 1.8.17. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers who have a valid booking session token to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the affected pages.
